capture.method: Viewport-only PNG frames of the actual owning-repository interface in one isolated headless Chromium tab.

source: Built-in development demo with four fictional conversations. Selecting the existing session cards changes the real activity panel. No collector or real notifications were enabled.
edits: Resized screenshots and encoded GIF/WebP with presentation pauses. No retouching, text replacement or invented controls.
coverageLimits: These visual captures do not establish installed-extension acceptance, signed native binary delivery, live integrations, real monitoring or production data verification.
